recognize_zh: CD5 染色中擴張的外套層細胞呈大片、強而一致的膜狀陽性，而生發中心內只有散在陽性 T 細胞；因 CD3 在外套層是陰性，表示這些 CD5 陽性細胞是異常 B 細胞。
features: Dense, uniform membranous CD5 staining of the expanded mantle zone population
Pale germinal centers containing only scattered CD5-positive T cells
Interfollicular areas with loosely scattered positive cells
Staining intensity in mantle zones comparable to T cells, in a sheet-like distribution
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD5 shows strong membranous staining of the monotonous lymphoid population filling the expanded mantle zones, while germinal centers contain only scattered CD5-positive T cells. Because the mantle zone cells are CD3-negative and CD20-positive on companion stains, the CD5 expression represents aberrant co-expression on B cells. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma with a mantle zone growth pattern, to be confirmed with cyclin D1 or SOX11.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL is CD5+ but CD23+ LEF1+ with proliferation centers and a diffuse pattern, and lacks cyclin D1/SOX11.
Reactive CD5+ cells are T cells that co-express CD3 and are located in the paracortex rather than filling mantle zones.
Rare MZL is CD5+ but lacks cyclin D1 and SOX11 and shows marginal zone/monocytoid expansion outside the mantle.
